desc: Hearth, campfire, burning building. Warmth or threat depending on level.
prompt: a wood fire burning close, dry logs popping and cracking irregularly, a low roar of flame underneath, embers ticking, close microphone, no wind
negative: music, speech, tonal, wind, rain, crowd
note: Irregular by nature, so it loops without an audible seam - one 12 s render covers a whole scene. The low roar underneath is what makes it read as a LARGE fire; a hearth is this same prompt with 'a low roar of flame underneath' deleted. That is the cheapest scale control in the library.
